Quick note from Nova: we're moving 12 seats (Engineering team) from our EU entity (Nova EU B.V.) to our US entity (Nova Inc.) effective 2027-07-01. This is a mid-cycle change — seats billed under EU entity through 06/30 and under US going forward.

Two asks:
- Can you confirm the pro-rata calculation and whether Redwood will issue a credit from the EU entity that we can apply to the next invoice, versus issuing a refund now?
- Our payments team had a charge declined for this account (MCC mismatch) so AP wants wire instructions for the interim amount so we don't delay provisioning. Can you provide bank wiring details and the expected pro-forma total?

Also: please confirm how add-ons (we have an ongoing GPU-burst add-on) are handled in the partial-month calculation. I'm attaching the signed amendment (signed_entity_amendment.pdf) that legal already completed.

Thanks — Elena

Subject: Re: Contract amendment: mid-month seat transfer & billing path

Hi Elena — thanks for the amendment, and for the heads-up. Good news: we can do a split-invoicing approach that keeps tax evidence clean. High level:

- EU entity (Nova EU B.V.) will be invoiced for usage and seats through 2027-06-30; Redwood will issue a credit note for the unused portion of seats starting 2027-07-01.
- US entity (Nova Inc.) will receive a new invoice starting 2027-07-01 (no EU VAT applied).

Pro-rata and add-ons: we calculate prorated charges at the per-seat daily rate plus prorated add-on usage (GPU-burst charged by minute/hour as in your contract). I can attach a quick calc file with line items — Marissa, can you prepare a pro-forma?

On the payment path: if the merchant is declining, we can accept a wire. Marissa will send bank details and a pro-forma total. For VAT: Karthik, can you confirm what we need from Elena (VAT IDs/legal names) to issue the EU credit note?

Action items:
- Marissa: provisional pro-forma (interim invoice) and bank details
- Karthik: VAT evidence & guidance for credit issuance
- Elena: confirmation whether you'd like an immediate refund or a credit applied to next invoice once we issue the credit note

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 12:45:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Contract amendment: mid-month seat transfer & billing path

Hi all — quick VAT/tax guidance.

1) For the EU credit note: we need the full legal name of the EU billing entity (as it appears on the amendment), the EU VAT ID, and the EU billing address. The credit will be issued from Redwood EU entity (we will not attempt to reverse-charge a credit).
2) For the new invoice to Nova Inc. (US), please provide the US legal entity name and EIN if you want it populated on the invoice; US invoices won't have VAT.
3) Timing: we can issue the credit note dated 2027-06-30 and a pro-forma for the interim balance today so AP can wire. Once we receive the wire we can clear any holds and finalize application of the credit (or process a refund per your choice).

If you want immediate refund instead of credit, note that refunds to cards can take 5–7 business days; wire refunds take longer and may incur bank fees — sometimes customers prefer credit to keep month-to-month continuity.

Attachment: vat_evidence_req.txt (list of required fields)

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Tax & Compliance, Redwood Inference

I'll ask AP to start a wire as soon as we have the pro-forma and bank details.

Thanks, Elena
